title: Sara Duterte defense presents SALNs of Marcos, Leni Robredo
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte"s defense counsel presented the Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. and former vice president and current…

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense counsel presented the Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. and former vice president and current Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo.
Defense counsel Mark Vinluan first presented Marcos’ report to AML (Anti-Money Laundering) Consulting PH head Rainer Dela Fuente and asked about the president’s declaration.

“He listed two, one is Araca Resources Corporation and the other one is El Paraiso Farms Incoeproarted… as a financial investigator, what comments do you have on the financial and business portion of PBBM’s SALN?” Vinluan asked Dela Fuente.
"As far as I can remember, this is harmless information," Dela Fuente said.
The prosecution in the impeachment trial, in its presentation on on alleged unexplained wealth, showed that Duterte had earned from business interests while she was already the vice president.
House prosecutor Chel Diokno initially objected to the question on Marcos' SALN, saying that it was irrelevant and immaterial.
“It is the respondent who is on trial in the case, and whatever is maybe on the SALN of another official, really has nothing to do with any of the issues here,” Diokno said.

Senate impeachment presiding officer Francis Escudero said the court has previously discussed past presidents who have also disclosed their business interests in their SALN without raising further investigations. He allowed the question to be asked.

“As a financial investigator I will only take note of this business interest, there is nothing adverse with this disclosure, so we’ll take note of this information and if later on, we’ll stumble upon another data that might elicit linking with this entity, business interests, then we’ll use that,” Dela Fuente said.

While Vinluan did not initially state which SALN year he presented, the total amount declared of P960.7 million matched Marcos’ 2022 SALN. Vinluan also showed Marcos’ 2023 SALN, which showed that he maintained those business interests, as well as increasing his total value to P1.1 billion.
Robredo’s SALN was also presented, which showed that she had Meralco stocks. However, it was not specified which year of SALN this was. Vinluan asked Dela Fuente for comments.
“A typical financial investigator would take note of this information. It’s harmless as it is,” Dela Fuente said. —NB, GMA News
